title: Aureline benchmark corpus-manifest object
description: Boundary schema for a single named benchmark corpus-manifest object. A corpus manifest is the canonical identity of one governed corpus revision: its stable id, its corpus class, the bound revision a metric must equal to stay comparable, its license / redaction / retention / access posture, whether it needs external review before CI, its freshness rule, the permitted workload classes it may back, its owner, and the canonical source register it projects from. A protected metric binds to one or more of these ids rather than to raw fixture paths; a metric on a stale revision or with no resolvable corpus id fails closed. Raw fixture bytes, raw customer or repository names, and secret material never cross this boundary; only stable ids and reviewable sentences do.

corpus_ref.description: Stable corpus id resolvable in the canonical corpus register; never a raw fixture path.

bound_revision.description: Corpus-manifest revision this object is bound to; a value behind the current register revision fires stale_corpus_revision.

external_review_required.description: True when partner, customer, or field-derived material must clear licensing / redaction / retention review before CI use.

permitted_workload_classes.description: Workload classes this corpus is allowed to back; a metric that uses it outside these classes is non-conforming.

manifest_source_ref.description: Repo-relative canonical register this corpus id projects from (e.g. fixtures/benchmarks/corpus_manifest.yaml).

reviewable_sentence.description: Short product-term sentence safe for product copy, docs, support export, and release evidence. Raw fixture bytes, raw customer or repository names, and secret material MUST NOT appear.
